title: Zesty Peruvian Basmati Fritters
description: Quick, briny fritters that combine aromatic basmati rice, savory dashi, and zesty lime for a keto-friendly Peruvian snack.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook 200 g basmati rice until tender, about 18 minutes.
Drain the rice and let it cool to room temperature.
In a bowl, whisk together the cooled rice, 1 tsp dashi extract, 1 egg, 50 g almond flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Stir in 1 tbsp lime zest and 1 tbsp chopped cilantro until evenly distributed.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the skillet, flattening them slightly to form fritters.
Cook each fritter for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden and crisp.
Transfer finished fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve warm with a squeeze of fresh lime or a side of spicy ají sauce.
